plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.
This significantly reduces your true leverage and potential drawdown.
We will also trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name concentration limit.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation with a potential return of ~1.5% per month. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration, leading to lower expected drawdowns.

plan: For balanced growth, we will trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to reduce overall leverage.
QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to meet the single name concentration limit.
We will buy TSLA at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a moderate level of exposure.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5% per month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: For aggressive growth, we will add to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to increase exposure.
QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to meet the single name concentration limit.
We will buy TSLA at 6% as a strong scanner setup, leaning into high-conviction plays.
This plan uses leverage and concentration to target higher returns, with strict stop discipline.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretch growth, targeting ~4% per month. It significantly increases leverage and concentration, which can lead to higher upside but also much larger drawdowns. Daily decay and rebalancing of leveraged ETFs are a factor, requiring strict stop discipline.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, PLTU, MSFU) to zero.
This reduces high-beta exposure and potential volatility.
We will add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on stable income and low drawdown, acting as a cash-like alternative.
income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1% per month. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by eliminating leveraged and high-beta holdings, focusing on income-generating ETFs. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
